title: Wing Trailing Edge Harnesses — Fuel Quantity and Flap Position Run
abstract: Wiring sheet for the wing trailing edge harness run, covering the fuel quantity harness clipped to the lower cover inside the tank and the flap position sensing that continues aft of the rear spar.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the wing trailing edge harness run, including the fuel quantity harness that crosses the wing box and the flap position sensing that continues aft to the trailing edge.
sections.sheet_note: The fuel quantity harness portion of this run is inside the tank and is clipped to the lower cover on a single clamp line running outboard from the side of body. Clamp positions are dimensioned from the rib stations and the bracket feet are riveted to the cover skin at the positions shown. Wire numbering restarts at each rib station.
sections.routing_note: The run leaves the wing junction at the side of body, passes into the tank through the sealed penetration, and runs outboard along the lower cover to the outboard quantity probe. The flap position portion leaves the tank at rib 14, crosses the rear spar and continues aft in the fixed trailing edge structure to the flap track positions. Clamp spacing inside the tank is 220 mm nominal and is not adjustable, because the spacing sets the harness natural frequency.

title: Wing Trailing Edge Harnesses — Fuel Quantity and Flap Position Run

issue.reason: A second clamp line is drawn for the reinforced stringer run-out between ribs 8 and 14, with the two bracket positions inside the build-up moved inboard on the drawing.

abstract: Wiring sheet for the wing trailing edge harness run, covering the fuel quantity harness through the wing box and the flap position sensing, with the clamp positions that move when the lower cover is reinforced.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the wing trailing edge harness run, including the fuel quantity harness that crosses the wing box and the flap position sensing that continues aft to the trailing edge.
sections.sheet_note: The fuel quantity harness portion of this run is inside the tank and is clipped to the lower cover. On aircraft that have the reinforced stringer run-out, the clamp positions between ribs 8 and 14 move 40 mm inboard to clear the pad, and the sheet shows both clamp lines. Two bracket feet fall inside the build-up area: their rivets cannot be set into the thicker laminate on the original centres, so on the reinforced standard they pick up the new fastener pattern of the pad and are shown against it. A harness re-clipped on the original line after a tank entry will foul the pad; this has already been reported twice. Wire numbering restarts at each rib station.
sections.routing_note: The run leaves the wing junction at the side of body, passes into the tank through the sealed penetration, and runs outboard along the lower cover to the outboard quantity probe. The flap position portion leaves the tank at rib 14, crosses the rear spar and continues aft in the fixed trailing edge structure to the flap track positions. Clamp spacing inside the tank is 220 mm nominal and is not adjustable, because the spacing sets the harness natural frequency.
